description: This source file defines classes related to the local partition of the Grain Directory in Orleans Runtime. It manages grain activation addresses and their associated metadata, supports operations like adding, removing, merging, and splitting grain entries, and includes logging for traceability.

classes.name: GrainInfo
classes.description: Represents information about a grain's activation, including address, creation time, and version tag. Provides methods to manage activation addresses and determine if a grain can be removed.

classes.name: LocalGrainDirectoryPartition
classes.description: Manages a partition of the grain directory, supporting operations like adding, removing, merging, splitting, and updating grain entries with thread safety and logging.

methods.name: AddSingleActivation
methods.description: Adds a new activation address for a grain, creating a new GrainInfo if necessary.

methods.name: RemoveActivation
methods.description: Removes an activation address of a grain based on activation id and cause.

methods.name: RemoveGrain
methods.description: Removes the entire grain entry and its activations from the partition.

methods.name: LookUpActivation
methods.description: Retrieves the activation address and version tag for a grain.

methods.name: GetGrainETag
methods.description: Returns the version (ETag) of the grain's activation list.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Merges another partition into this one; used during silo handoff, and returns activations to deactivate.

methods.name: Split
methods.description: Partitions entries based on a predicate, used during system rebalancing.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Replaces the internal partition data with a new dataset.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Applies delta updates to the partition data, adding or removing entries as specified.
